text:
ryan_pm: Heads-up — we need to lock a time for a cross-functional sync next week to do roadmap alignment + RFC triage. 30m. Owners: engineering + product to bring short pre-reads.

maya_prod: Tue/Wed 10-11am PT generally best for product. 30m works. What do you want on the agenda?

jamie_eng: Tue 10am PT works for eng. I'd like to focus on the kv-cache rollout RFC and the smart routing policy follow-up. I can own the eng agenda.

oliver_design: Wed morning is easier for design, Tue clashes with a user research block. Can we record? Otherwise I can give a quick write-up in doc.

priyanka_sre: Heads up i'm OOO Tue morning for infra work. Thu afternoon is open. Also flag: any rollout discussion should include eng-sre; might need a 5m sync after this call.

ryan_pm: Options: Tue 10am PT / Wed 9am PT / Thu 2pm PT. Please react :thumbsup: to the slot that works or propose another. Quick proposed agenda below — owners add 1-line pre-read by EOD Mon.

```
Proposed agenda (30m):
1) Quick status & blockers (5m)
2) RFC reviews (15m) — owners present 2 slides or 3 bullets each (kv-cache: jamie_eng; routing: devon_eng)
3) Decision log updates (5m) — owner: ryan_pm (capture yes/no + rollout date)
4) Actions & next steps (5m)
Prep: owners drop a 3-bullet summary + risk/rollout note in this thread before meeting.
```

devon_eng: I can cover routing. Tue 10 PT is ok for me. I'll drop the 3-bullet pre-read by EOD Mon.

maya_prod: If Oliver can't make Tue we'll still do it — design can sync async. I'll own product context and tradeoffs.

oliver_design: Ok i'll watch the recording and put design notes in the doc. If there's a design decision needed, ping me in-thread before the meetup.

priyanka_sre: If we lock Tue, i'll add infra risks to the thread and sync with eng-sre after the call. If folks prefer Thu for SRE presence, say so.

jamie_eng: Vote: lock Tue 10am PT. Owner(s): jamie_eng & devon_eng for RFCs. ryan_pm will own the decision log.

ryan_pm: Sounds like a consensus. Locking Tue 10:00 PT — 30m. Owners: jamie_eng, devon_eng. Decision-log owner: ryan_pm. Recording + notes will be posted to the decision log doc. If you can't make it, leave a :wave: and add pre-reads.

calendar_bot: Event created — "Crossfunc Sync: roadmap + RFCs" — Tue 10:00 PT — host: ryan_pm.

ryan_pm: Thanks all — please add pre-reads by EOD Mon and flag any must-discuss items. We'll keep the meeting tight and push detailed follow-ups to a second follow-up if needed.
